scheme: 47-tile blob. Build an 8-bit mask of neighbours that are WATER (or off-map counts as water): NE=1 (r-1,c), E=2 (r-1,c+1), SE=4 (r,c+1), S=8 (r+1,c+1), SW=16 (r+1,c), W=32 (r+1,c-1), NW=64 (r,c-1), N=128 (r-1,c-1). Screen: x=(c-r)*16, y=(c+r)*8. Clear a corner bit unless both its edge bits are set (E needs NE+SE, S needs SE+SW, W needs SW+NW, N needs NW+NE). Column = index of the reduced mask in "masks". Mask 255 = open water (same look as water.png). Land tiles need nothing: the bank is drawn inside the water tile.
